lines.say: Five levels. Israel climbed them backwards.
In nineteen forty three, Abraham Maslow drew a pyramid of human needs.
Basics at the bottom. Dreams at the top.
Israel built it upside down. And started at the top.
Self actualisation? Fourteen Nobel prizes since nineteen forty eight.
And the highest research spending of any rich country: six point three five percent.
Esteem? Four Eurovision wins. Very important for national security.
Belonging? Almost three kids per woman. Friday dinner is a crowd.
Every new home since nineteen ninety three needs a safe room. Fifty six percent still don't have one.
And the basics? In a desert, eighty six percent of drinking water comes from the sea.
Maslow said: fix the basics, then dream.
Israel said: dream first. The basics will catch up.
The result? The eighth happiest country on Earth.
Which level should Israel fix next?
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
Five levels. And Israel climbed them backwards.

caption_en:
Maslow would need a minute with this one. 🔺

In 1943 Abraham Maslow drew a pyramid of human needs: basics and safety first, dreams last. Israel built it upside down:

🚀 Self actualisation: 14 Israeli Nobel laureates since 1948 (latest: Joel Mokyr, 2025). Research spending 6.35% of GDP, the highest in the OECD, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD MSTI, 2023 data).
🏆 Esteem: 4 Eurovision wins (1978, 1979, 1998, 2018).
💛 Belonging: 2.9 children per woman, the highest in the OECD (OECD 2024; Israel CBS: 2.88 in 2025).
🛡️ Safety: a protected room (mamad) is required in every new home since a 1993 law, yet 56% of households still have none (Israel Builders Association, 2025).
💧 Basics: about 86% of drinking water came from desalination in 2022 (Israel Water Authority data).

The result: 8th happiest country on Earth (World Happiness Report 2026).

Big on dreams. Basics still unfinished.

Which level should Israel fix next? Tell me in the comments.

caption_he:
מאסלו צייר ב־1943 פירמידת צרכים: קודם בסיס וביטחון, ורק בסוף חלומות. ישראל בנתה אותה הפוך.
14 זוכי נובל, 6.35% מהתוצר על מחקר (הכי גבוה ב־OECD), 4 זכיות באירוויזיון, 2.9 ילדים לאישה.
אבל 56% מהדירות עדיין בלי ממ"ד, ו־86% ממי השתייה מגיעים מהים.
והתוצאה? המדינה השמינית הכי מאושרת בעולם.
איזו קומה ישראל צריכה לתקן קודם?
